title: Розыгрыш для Кати  (A Prank on Katya)

segments.t: At home late at night, Nastya wakes up with a sudden craving, while the next morning in the locker room Senya and Fedya plant a fake mouse in Katya's locker to scare her.
Но штуку я всё равно выиграл.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Well, blow me down!' Senya speaks steadily across the room, letting the remark speak for itself.
'I left it myself, I don't remember where.' Senya speaks firmly with Kostya and uses "ostavila" ("left", from "ostavit") to make the point stick.
'Nastya, where are you?' Speaking briskly at once, Kostya links the Russian words directly in the present with no word for "am", "is", or "are" needed.
'I felt like having a little apple.' Nastya chimes in pointedly with a nod, watching Kostya's face to see how the news lands.
'Let me peel it.' Kostya chimes in vividly right here and leans on "pochishchu" ("will peel, clean", a form of "pochistit") to give the remark its edge.
'No, go to sleep.' Reacting briskly on the spot, spoken Russian compresses the whole thought into just 3 words, skipping the extra helper words English needs.
'They brought him that fugu fish.' Senya speaks quietly with a nod, leaving no doubt about where he stands.
'He ate it and died.' Senya follows up openly in the exchange and lands on "pomer" ("died", built on "pomeret") to keep the statement grounded.
'Then it turned out to be a stroke.' Turning to a stroke beside Nastya, the "-sya" ending on "okazalsya" ("turned up") marks an action that unfolds mutually or turns back on the speaker.
Но штуку я всё равно выиграл.
'But I still won a grand anyway.' Senya cuts in frankly with a sigh, steering the talk right where he wants it.
'Hand it over!' Senya steps in naturally at once and uses "otday" ("give back", from "otdat") to make the point stick.
'Nicely done!' Speaking naturally at once, spoken Russian compresses the whole thought into just 1 words, skipping the extra helper words English needs.
Но штуку я всё равно выиграл.
And that finishes Scene Three. Listen out for Nastya's late-night apple excuse and Senya's tall tale about the fugu fish bet. Until next time!
